# Cognitive Toolworks

> AI-Native Skill Forge: Generate cross-platform agent artifacts (SKILL.md, AGENTS.md) using LLM intelligence.

Cognitive Toolworks is a Python library and CLI for generating, validating, and managing AI agent artifacts. It supports both Anthropic (Claude) and OpenAI (Codex) platforms with cross-platform skill generation.

## Key Documentation

- [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md): Authoritative rules for the repository (single source of truth)
- [README.md](./README.md): Quick start guide and feature overview
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): Developer instructions for contributing
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution guidelines

## Skills Library

This repository contains 80 production-ready skills following the Anthropic SKILL.md format.

- [index/skills-index.json](./index/skills-index.json): Searchable index of all skills
- [skills/](./skills/): Individual skill directories with SKILL.md files

Skill categories: API design, cloud architecture (AWS/Azure/GCP), security, testing, DevOps, compliance, observability, and more.

## Agents Library

18 orchestrator agents that coordinate multiple skills for complex workflows.

- [index/agents-index.json](./index/agents-index.json): Searchable index of all agents
- [agents/](./agents/): Individual agent directories with AGENT.md files

Agent types: Testing orchestrator, security auditor, cloud orchestrators, compliance, disaster recovery, and more.

## CLI Commands

```bash
ct ls                              # List all skills
ct search <term>                   # Search skills/agents
ct show <slug>                     # View skill/agent details
ct validate <path>                 # Validate against specs
ct generate skill --from-mcp      # Generate from MCP server
ct generate skill --from-readme   # Generate from README
ct generate skill --from-openapi  # Generate from OpenAPI spec
ct generate agents-md             # Generate AGENTS.md
ct optimize <path>                # LLM-powered optimization
ct security-scan <path>           # Security scanning
```

## Source Code

- [src/cognitive_toolworks/](./src/cognitive_toolworks/): Main Python package
- [src/cognitive_toolworks/cli.py](./src/cognitive_toolworks/cli.py): CLI implementation
- [src/cognitive_toolworks/generators/](./src/cognitive_toolworks/generators/): Skill and agent generators
- [src/cognitive_toolworks/validators/](./src/cognitive_toolworks/validators/): Platform validators
- [src/cognitive_toolworks/templates/](./src/cognitive_toolworks/templates/): Jinja2 templates

## Tooling

- [tooling/validate_skill.py](./tooling/validate_skill.py): Skill validation script
- [tooling/build_index.py](./tooling/build_index.py): Index generation script
- [tooling/analyze_coverage.py](./tooling/analyze_coverage.py): Coverage analysis
